verdict.rationale: Justworks is a payroll, HR and PEO SaaS that holds sensitive employee data, so whether customers can stop that data being used for AI training is a fair privacy question. The evidence pack covers only payroll, benefits, time off, onboarding and Xero integration, and nothing in it mentions AI training, opt-outs, or data-use policies.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
